theorem: With finite action-labelled guarded relation P(b,a), let S_b={a:P(b,a)}. Remove a row b if another row b' has S_b' a strict subset of S_b, deduplicating equal rows but preserving all original labels. The inclusion-minimal row signatures preserve BOTH forall b exists a P(b,a) and exists a forall b P(b,a): former iff every minimal row is nonempty; latter iff the intersection of minimal rows is nonempty. Every labelled binary fixed-horizon per-reply outcome is reconstructed from retained input signatures.
